title: Core update, complete and handoff still read @file arguments with no ceiling
outcome: Only CoreWorkCommand::Propose moved to the bounded JSON reader; core update, complete and handoff still use the unbounded reader with a whole-file read, so an oversized operator-supplied file is read entirely before any limit applies.
acceptance: core update, complete and handoff use the bounded JSON reader, and an oversized file is refused before it is read whole

completion.summary: Four core inputs share the 2 MiB bounded JSON reader; oversized @file refused before whole-file read.
